posture_metrics.angle_definition: world down to knee-to-foot-center vector; 90 deg is horizontal
posture_metrics.clearance_scope: knee joint origin above highest terrain vertically below; not collision-surface clearance or side-riser distance
posture_metrics.contact_scope: fraction of 20ms policy intervals with any geometric contact; loaded contact additionally requires >1N normal force in any 5ms physics substep

per_leg_contacts.scope: post-step sampled angle gated by any >1 N contact during preceding 20 ms; not instantaneous phase/force correlation

posture_metrics.scope: post-warmup saved policy-boundary poses, all terrain phases; sparse stride if requested

recorded_input_mirror_probe.scope: exact recorded noisy frame history; mirrored policy inputs, no second physics rollout

symmetry_metrics.scope: full post-warmup trial means; mean bias is phase averaged but stair sequencing can differ; neutral probe is off-trajectory and diagnostic only

gait_metrics.scope: finite difference of post-step foot centers; gated by >threshold peak normal force in both adjacent 20 ms intervals; proxy, not contact-point tangential slip; world-z span is only a swing proxy on flat terrain
